youtube.description:
Uncle ne poocha: "Operation se pehle nahana zaroori hai kya?" 🛁
Dr Saathi ne kaha: haan! Saaf skin matlab kam infection. 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Operation se ek din pehle ya usi din sabun se nahaiye
✅ Isse skin ke germs kam hote hain
✅ Khud razor se baal mat hataiye, infection ka khatra badhta hai
✅ Zaroorat ho toh hospital staff clipper se karega
